def pw(z,k=8):
    lo,hi=z.min(),z.max(); u=(z-lo)/(hi-lo)
    cols=[u**p for p in range(1,4)]+[np.maximum(u-c,0)**3 for c in np.linspace(0,1,k)[1:-1]]
    return cols
